newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's tax revenues increase in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's tax revenues increase in first quarter.

text.p: Mexico's tax revenues rose in the first quarter of this year, with increases in both income and value-added taxes compared to the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said in a report on Thursday.

Revenues from the value-added tax, IVA, rose to 23.329 billion pesos in the first quarter compared to 20.776 billion pesos in the first quarter of 1996 and 17.798 billion pesos in the same quarter in 1995.
Income tax revenues were 30.104 billion pesos in the first quarter of the year, comapred to 25.789 billion pesos in the same quarter a year earlier.
However, the first quarter income tax revenues were still down compared to the first quarter of 1995, when they were 34.647 billion pesos, the finance ministry said.
